draft_en.subject: Beside the E-wind converters on lanshack.com - two numbers and a 2-piece sample
draft_en.body:
Hi Andrea,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Beside the E-wind converters and switches on lanshack.com, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity: industrial Gigabit media converter, DIN-rail, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot, -40 to 75 C - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD; industrial 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-288GP - $60. FCC/CE/RoHS, no UL listing - said up front. Samples are paid at the same price.

One question: would a 2-piece sample help you compare build quality against the E-wind units you already stock?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
